concept: Measurement of R/L/C Using Bridge Circuits
question: Consider two coils, A, having larger number of turns than B, kept axially at a distance from each other. The coil A is connected to a battery and a switch and B is connected to a galvanometer . On switching on or off the circuit a DC current flows through the coil A, then deflection in the galvanometer connected to coil B can be increased by winding the core of coil B on ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**an iron rod.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Galvanometer:**

 
 
• An instrument called a galvanometer is **used to identify or quantify tiny electric currents.**
 
• The movement of a coil in a magnetic field, which is a crucial component of a galvanometer, or a magnetic needle in a magnetic field typically indicate the current and its intensity.
 
 
 
• **The deflection in the galvanometer connected to coil B can be increased by winding the core of coil B on an iron rod.**
 
• This is because** iron is a** **magnetic material** and** it enhances the magnetic field produced by the current flowing through coil A, thereby increasing the strength of the induced current in coil B.**
 
• Iron is a ferromagnetic material, which means it can be magnetized and has a strong attraction to magnets.
 
• It is important to note that the distance between the two coils also affects the **deflection **in the galvanometer.
 
• The closer the coils are, the **stronger** the induced current in coil B will be.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Ebonite:**

 
 
• It is a type of hard rubber that is often used in **electrical insulators** and equipment due to its **non-conductive properties.**
 
• If an ebonite rod is used, it will not enhance the magnetic field as it is a non-magnetic material.
 
 
 
• **Wooden Rod:**
 
 
• It** **is a **non-magnetic materials **and are often used as insulators in electrical equipment.
 
• It is also non-magnetic materials and **will not enhance the magnetic field.**
 
 
 
• **Glass Rod:**
 
 
• It is a non-magnetic materials and are often used as insulators in electrical equipment.
 
• It is also non-magnetic materials and will not enhance the magnetic field.
